goals.objective: Build one complete polished web GameBook app in /Users/gkk/Documents/GameBook. Deliver a nostalgic tactile choose-your-own-adventure book themed '자고 일어났더니 바게트 빵으로 싸워야 하는 세계에서 내가 용사로 태어났다고?' with 150+ navigable story pages, 10+ endings including good and bad/death endings, page-turn UI, zoom controls, polished responsive UX, and 200+ workspace raster assets derived from imagegen output, with no SVG mock production assets. Verification must include test-first RED->GREEN evidence for story graph, asset manifest, UI navigation, and browser e2e; manual browser QA must capture cover choice navigation, zoom behavior, and good/bad ending routes with cleanup receipts.

successCriteria.scenario: Browser happy path: start dev server, open http://127.0.0.1:4173, verify tactile book cover/spread renders, click the first visible choice, confirm page number changes from 1 and capture .omo/evidence/browser-cover-choice.png plus .omo/evidence/browser-cover-choice.json. Automated pair: tests/story-graph.test.ts, tests/gamebook-ui.test.tsx, tests/e2e/gamebook.spec.ts RED then GREEN.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/evidence/red-story-ui-e2e.txt and .omo/evidence/green-story-ui-e2e.txt; .omo/evidence/browser-cover-choice.png and .omo/evidence/browser-cover-choice.json; cleanup receipt for dev server PID, port release, browser context closed.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: PASS: RED evidence .omo/evidence/red-story-ui-e2e.txt and .omo/evidence/red-page-number-selector.txt; GREEN evidence .omo/evidence/check.txt, .omo/evidence/green-e2e.txt; browser happy path .omo/evidence/browser-cover-choice.png/.json shows page 1 to page 2 via actual choice; cleanup JSON has serverKilled=true, portReleased=true, browserContextClosed=true.

successCriteria.scenario: Edge/adversarial path: validate generated data has 150+ pages, 10+ endings, no invalid page references, no SVG production assets, at least 200 imagegen-derived raster asset files; in browser use zoom-in/zoom-out controls at desktop and mobile viewport and capture .omo/evidence/browser-zoom.png. Automated pair: tests/story-graph.test.ts and tests/asset-manifest.test.ts RED then GREEN.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/evidence/red-story-assets.txt and .omo/evidence/green-story-assets.txt; .omo/evidence/browser-zoom.png and .omo/evidence/browser-zoom.json; cleanup receipt for dev server PID, port release, browser context closed.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: PASS: Story/asset edge validation GREEN in .omo/evidence/green-story-state-effects.txt and .omo/evidence/green-asset-sources-dimensions.txt; asset hash audit .omo/evidence/asset-hash-audit.txt reports 240 assets, 240 unique hashes, 20 sources; .omo/evidence/no-svg-count.txt reports 0 SVG files; browser zoom/mobile evidence .omo/evidence/browser-zoom.png/.json and .omo/evidence/browser-mobile.png, cleanup receipts true.

successCriteria.scenario: Regression/completion path: run npm test, npm run build, TypeScript diagnostics, and browser routes to one good ending and one death/bad ending with restart; capture .omo/evidence/browser-endings.png and .omo/evidence/browser-endings.json. Automated pair: tests/e2e/gamebook.spec.ts and tests/gamebook-ui.test.tsx RED then GREEN.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/evidence/red-e2e-endings.txt and .omo/evidence/green-all.txt; .omo/evidence/build.txt; .omo/evidence/browser-endings.png and .omo/evidence/browser-endings.json; cleanup receipt for dev server PID, port release, browser context closed.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: PASS: Regression completion evidence .omo/evidence/npm-test.txt, .omo/evidence/build.txt, .omo/evidence/check.txt, .omo/evidence/lsp-diagnostics.txt, .omo/evidence/green-e2e.txt, .omo/evidence/browser-endings.png/.json, .omo/evidence/green-all.txt. Browser route used actual choice clicks to one good ending and one bad/death ending with restart; cleanup JSON true; final reviewer returned UNCONDITIONAL APPROVAL.

goals.evidence: .omo/evidence/green-all.txt; final_review UNCONDITIONAL APPROVAL; all C001-C003 criteria pass; browser QA cleanup true; LSP 0 diagnostics.
